privacy_policy_intro: OpenAthlete helps coaches and athletes collaborate. We use artificial intelligence to analyze training data, surface insights that help prevent injuries, and assist in planning and modifying training plans. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_2: Profile information (sport preferences, roles, timezone, language).
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_3: Training and activity data (planned sessions, completed activities, metrics, notes).
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_4: Device and connector data from integrated providers such as Garmin or Strava (activity files, GPS, heart rate, power, cadence, sleep, steps, body composition, wellness metrics), when you connect those services.
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_5: Health-related data that you choose to share (e.g., heart rate, HRV, VO₂max, injuries), which we treat as sensitive information.
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_7: AI interaction data (questions, prompts, model outputs) to provide and improve AI-assisted features.
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_8: Usage, diagnostics, and device information (logs, browser, IP, app performance) to maintain security and reliability.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_1: Provide the core service, including planning, tracking, and collaboration between coaches and athletes.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_2: Analyze and help modify training plans using AI, including insights to help reduce injury risk and optimize performance.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_3: Sync with connected providers (e.g., Garmin) to import activities and export workouts with your authorization.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_4: Communicate with you (service messages, notifications) and provide support.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_5: Maintain security, prevent abuse, and debug issues.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_6: Research and product improvement using aggregated or de-identified data whenever possible.
privacy_policy_legal_basis_list_1: Consent: for connecting third-party providers, processing sensitive health data, and receiving certain communications.
privacy_policy_legal_basis_list_2: Contract: to deliver the service you request and manage your account.
privacy_policy_legal_basis_list_3: Legitimate interests: to secure our services, prevent misuse, and improve features in a way that does not override your rights.
privacy_policy_sharing_list_1: Service providers (data hosting, analytics, customer support, AI infrastructure) under data processing agreements.
privacy_policy_sharing_list_2: Integrations you choose to connect (e.g., Garmin, Strava). We share or receive data strictly to provide the requested functionality.
privacy_policy_sharing_list_3: Coach–athlete collaboration: data you explicitly share within a space (e.g., plans, comments, metrics) is visible to invited members according to your settings.
privacy_policy_sharing_list_4: Legal compliance or to protect rights, safety, and security when required by law or to prevent fraud or abuse.
privacy_policy_data_retention_content: We keep personal data only as long as necessary to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. You may request deletion; some records may be retained as required by law or for legitimate business purposes.
privacy_policy_security_content: We apply administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect personal data, including encryption in transit, access controls, and monitoring. No system is 100% secure; we continuously improve our safeguards.
privacy_policy_international_transfers_c: If data is transferred internationally, we rely on lawful mechanisms (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses) and implement appropriate safeguards.
privacy_policy_your_rights_list_1: Access, correction, deletion, and portability of your data.
privacy_policy_your_rights_list_2: Restriction or objection to certain processing, including withdrawals of consent at any time.
privacy_policy_your_rights_list_3: Right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.
privacy_policy_children_content: OpenAthlete is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided personal data, contact us and we will take appropriate action.
privacy_policy_changes_content: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will post updates with a new effective date.
privacy_policy_contact_content: If you have questions or requests regarding privacy, contact us at contact@openathlete.org.

json_plan_example_replace: Replace the current JSON with the example?
json_plan_format_plan: plan: name, description, goal, sportType, distance in metres and duration, the total number of weeks, which must equal the weeks of all cycles.
json_plan_format_cycles: cycles: in order, each with a phase (BASE, SPECIFIC, TAPER, RECOVERY or COMPETITION) and its weeks. Each week lasts 7 days from the chosen start date.
json_plan_format_sessions: sessions: dayOfWeek 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday … 6 = Saturday; sport (RUNNING, CYCLING, STRENGTH…); goalDuration in seconds, goalDistance and goalElevationGain in metres, goalRpe from 0 to 10. They start at 9:00.
json_plan_format_steps: workout.steps (optional): stepType WARMUP, STEADY, INTERVAL_ACTIVE, INTERVAL_REST, COOLDOWN or REPEAT; durationType TIME (seconds), DISTANCE (metres) or LAP_BUTTON. Intervals are a REPEAT with repeatBlock (repetitions and childSteps), never nested.
json_plan_format_targets: targets: RPE with targetValue; heart rate relative to max with targetMin/targetMax between 0 and 1 and metricType HR_MAX; absolute pace in m/s (1000 ÷ seconds per km: 4:30/km = 3.70).
json_plan_format_limits: At most 90 kB, 104 weeks and 1,500 sessions. Unknown fields are rejected, and any error shows here before you publish.
json_plan_review_help: Review all sessions before publishing them to the selected athlete’s calendar. Validation checks the format, not the suitability of the training load.
json_plan_schedule_help: Sessions start at 09:00 ({timeZone}). Weeks span seven days from the selected date. Missing duration reserves 60 minutes.
json_plan_replace_warning: All sessions in “{name}” will be replaced. Only future plans without activities, comments, templates or exports can be replaced.
json_plan_races_kept: Races kept: {races}. Their events are never replaced.
json_plan_race_unlinked: {name} falls outside the new plan: it stays in the calendar but is unlinked.
json_plan_confirm: I have reviewed the athlete, dates, sessions and replacement, if selected.
json_plan_metadata_help: Plan-level sport, distance, target time and elevation range are reference metadata. Session targets are saved; those plan-level values are not saved as structured goals.
adaptation_help: Review the next session or the remaining sessions of a week using the athlete’s current state. Changes require your approval.
adaptation_week_start: First day of the week to review
adaptation_allow_increase: Allow increasing load of existing sessions
adaptation_limit_help: The increase limit is a technical constraint, not a guarantee of appropriate training load. Completed activities stay intact. Exported workouts cannot be changed here.
adaptation_context_help: Generating sends this context to the configured AI provider: plan, recent activities, available recovery metrics and your current-state notes. Missing data stays unknown.
adaptation_confirm: I reviewed the changes, workout steps and any increase in load.
adaptation_redistribute_help: AI may suggest new dates within the selected period and the original plan week. Review dates before accepting. Completed activities are not moved.
adaptation_add_sessions: Allow adding sessions alongside adapting existing ones
adaptation_add_help: Available when recovered. Check the selected week and set the maximum number of new sessions, their total minutes and maximum RPE. This time is added to the plan, independently of the percentage increase for existing sessions. New sessions use duration and RPE prescriptions.
adaptation_no_sessions: No pending sessions belonging to the selected plan start in the future within this period. Check athlete, plan, week and time. A standalone calendar session may not belong to this plan. To add sessions to an empty week, enable “Allow adding new sessions”.
adaptation_no_week: The selected period contains no future week of this plan. Choose a week within its dates.
adaptation_new_permission: Adding sessions requires weekly scope, recovered state and explicit permission. Unresolved recorded injuries block additions.
adaptation_new_budget_error: New sessions exceed the authorized count, total minutes or RPE. Reduce the proposal or review those limits.
adaptation_date_error: Proposed dates must be in the future and inside the permitted period and plan week.
adaptation_overlap_error: Proposed sessions overlap. Review dates and durations before applying.
adaptation_redistribution_error: Enable redistribution before changing session dates.
adaptation_increase_error: The increase exceeds the authorized limit, lacks a baseline or is blocked by athlete state.
adaptation_invalid_error: The request or proposal failed validation. Review fields and limits or generate a new proposal. No changes were saved.
adaptation_stale_error: The calendar or athlete data changed. Generate and review a new proposal.
adaptation_access_error: You do not have access to this athlete, plan or AI feature.
adaptation_discuss_help: Describe changes or ask about the proposal. AI receives the draft and the last ten revisions. Nothing is saved until you accept; changing permissions or context starts a new proposal.
adaptation_feedback: For example: keep Sunday, shorten Thursday and explain why.
adaptation_minutes_ceiling_help: This is an upper limit across all new sessions, not a target. AI may propose fewer minutes and fewer sessions when appropriate.
adaptation_model_invalid: The AI response has an invalid format. Generate another proposal or retry the revision. No changes were saved.
adaptation_structure_error: Workout blocks have an unsupported structure: check durations, block types and repeats.
adaptation_target_error: Block targets are invalid: check ranges, athlete zones and the RPE ceiling.
adaptation_duration_error: Block duration does not match the session duration, or exceeds it.
adaptation_ids_error: The proposal omits, duplicates or changes eligible session identifiers.
adaptation_keep_error: AI marked a session as unchanged but edited its content or date. It must preserve it exactly or mark it as an update.
adaptation_rest_error: A rest session must have zero goals and no workout blocks.
adaptation_baseline_error: Cannot increase a duration that was not explicitly prescribed.
adaptation_empty_error: The proposal contains no sessions to save.
adaptation_invalid_draft: This draft needs correction and cannot be applied. Ask AI to correct it or edit it; the server validates it again when saving.
adaptation_permissions_help: Existing sessions may be kept, reduced or adapted without checking any box. “Increase load” permits exceeding their goals within the authorized percentage. “Add sessions” permits additional sessions with a separate maximum budget. Both options combine; neither replaces the other. Everything is limited to the next session or selected seven-day period, not the entire plan.
adaptation_raw_help: This response does not yet have a valid structure. Read it and request corrections in the chat below. It cannot be applied to the calendar.
adaptation_raw_missing: The provider did not return recoverable text. Ask the AI to regenerate it from the context.

ai_plan_failed_quota: The instance's AI account has no credit left. Your answers are fine: ask the administrator to add credit, then try again.

ai_plan_error_race_before_start: The race must be after the plan start.
ai_plan_error_long_day: Choose one of the training days.
ai_plan_review_help: Review and edit the draft. It is imported as a draft plan: activate it from Planning when it is ready.
ai_plan_checks_ok: The plan passes the automatic checks.
ai_plan_checks_fix: Fix these in the plan text before importing:
ai_plan_rules_help: The checks use these limits. The AI changes them only when your methodology or notes ask for it; you can adjust them within safe bounds and the checks run again.
ai_plan_rule_max_loading_weeks: Loading weeks before a recovery week
ai_plan_rule_taper_last_week: Race week (% of the peak week)
ai_plan_rule_taper_week_before: Week before the race (% of the peak week)
ai_plan_rule_injury_rpe: Highest RPE in weeks 1–2 with injuries
ai_plan_conflict_sessions: There are already {count} sessions in these dates. They are kept: review the calendar after importing.
ai_plan_issue_week_count: The plan has {value} weeks; it should have {limit}.
ai_plan_issue_week_numbers: Weeks must be numbered 1, 2, 3… in order.
ai_plan_issue_after_race: Week {week}, {session}: on or after race day.
ai_plan_issue_too_many_sessions: Week {week}: {value} sessions on one day (at most {limit}).
ai_plan_issue_sport_not_allowed: Week {week}, {session}: a sport not chosen for the plan.
ai_plan_issue_week_too_long: Week {week}: {value} min, more than the {limit} min available.
ai_plan_issue_first_week: Week 1: {value} min is a big jump from recent training (at most {limit} min).
ai_plan_issue_progression: Week {week}: {value} min grows too fast (at most {limit} min).
ai_plan_issue_no_recovery: Week {week}: more than {limit} loading weeks in a row; add a recovery week.
ai_plan_issue_no_taper: Week {week}: {value} min is not a taper (at most {limit} min).
ai_plan_issue_injury_intensity: Week {week}, {session}: RPE {value} with unresolved injuries (at most {limit} in weeks 1 and 2).
ai_plan_issue_unknown_zone: Week {week}, {session}: refers to a zone the athlete does not have.
ai_plan_issue_unknown_metric: Week {week}, {session}: refers to a metric the athlete does not have.
ai_plan_steps_help: The AI turns each session's description into steps for the watch, week by week. A session it cannot structure keeps its description.
ai_plan_steps_stopped: Stopped. Weeks already structured are kept.
workspace_empty_weeks_help: Empty weeks will be created between these dates. Then add sessions from the calendar and define races.
workspace_races_help: One target race and earlier preparation races within the plan dates. Races are calendar competitions. Unlinking keeps them in the calendar.
workspace_no_races: No races are linked to this plan yet.
workspace_injuries_help: Athlete records shared across plans. Describe reported symptoms and known restrictions. AI adaptation reads unresolved injuries.
workspace_no_plans: This athlete has no plans yet. Create one or import JSON.
workspace_calendar_help: New sessions will be added to this plan’s weeks. The calendar also shows the athlete’s other events.
workspace_calendar_mode_help: No plan selected: you see the athlete's calendar as it is, including sessions added or moved by hand. The AI assistant and adaptation work on it too.
workspace_conflict: Could not save: check whether the plan exists, is closed, already has a target race, or the competition is completed or shared. Refresh before retrying.
workspace_invalid: Check the fields and dates. Races must be within the plan and preparation races before the target race. The change was not saved.
workspace_failed: Could not load or save the information. Check your connection and try again.
bulk_workouts_help: Select the uncompleted workouts to delete. Completed activities and competitions are excluded from this selection.
bulk_workouts_confirm: You are about to delete {count} workouts. Review the list: this action cannot be undone.
bulk_workouts_failed: Deleted: {deleted}. Could not delete: {failed}. Review the remaining selection before retrying.
fit_import_help: Upload the FIT or GPX files of completed activities, one or several at a time. They appear in your calendar on their original date. FIT files keep laps and the device summary; for GPX files, distance, moving time and elevation gain are calculated from the track. Maps and charts depend on the data in each file.
fit_import_file: FIT or GPX files (up to 20 MB each)
fit_import_already: This file was already imported. No duplicate activity was created.
fit_import_invalid: This is not a valid activity FIT file. Check that it is not a planned workout or a damaged file.
fit_import_limit: The file exceeds import limits: 20 MB, 100,000 samples or 1,000 laps.
fit_import_multisport: Only one session per file is currently supported. Export multisport activities separately.
fit_import_duplicate_time: An activity already exists with this start date and time. Check your calendar before importing another file.
fit_import_forbidden: You can only import activities into your own athlete account.
fit_import_failed: The import could not be completed. You can retry with the same file without duplicating the activity.
fit_import_processing_pending: The activity is saved, but processing could not be queued. Import the same file again to retry.
fit_import_incomplete: Incomplete series were omitted to avoid associating samples with incorrect timestamps.
fit_import_no_stream: The file only contains a summary: there are no series for charts or maps.
fit_import_missing_summary: Distance or elevation gain is missing and cannot be calculated from the series. These values are stored as 0; you can review them in the activity.
fit_import_unknown_sport: Unrecognized sport: saved as Other. You can edit it.
fit_import_names_from_files: Each activity takes the track name stored in its GPX, or else its file name.
fit_import_skipped: Left out because they are not FIT or GPX files or exceed 20 MB: {files}
activity_import_unsupported: Choose a .fit or .gpx file of a completed activity.
gpx_import_sport_help: Applies to GPX files, which do not always state the sport. If it is missing or not recognized, the activity is saved as Other.
gpx_import_invalid: This is not a valid GPX file with a recorded track.
gpx_import_no_time: This GPX has no times: it looks like a planned route, not a completed activity.
gpx_import_no_gps: The file has no positions (for example, a treadmill run): there is no map and the distance is 0.
consent_description: We would like to measure how the app is used (product analytics and masked session recordings) to improve it. Nothing is collected until you accept, and you can change your choice in Settings > Profile.
consent_settings_granted: You allow product analytics and session recordings.
consent_settings_denied: Product analytics and session recordings are off.
privacy_section_description: Control what is collected and take your data with you.
data_export_description: One JSON file with your profile, workouts, activities, metrics, the messages you wrote and your settings. Passwords and keys are never included.
data_export_include_streams: Include activity streams (GPS, heart rate), for a larger file
data_export_failed: The export failed. Try again later.
assistant_help: Review athlete context and discuss the week with AI. This conversation does not change the calendar or sync Garmin.
assistant_history_help: The conversation is temporary: the last 8 exchanges are kept while you stay on this tab. It is cleared when you change athlete, plan, language, period or current state, or leave the tab.
assistant_context_help: Sending a question shares the available athlete context and recent conversation with the configured AI provider. You can review the data first. Each answer fetches current OpenAthlete data again.
assistant_empty: Ask about planned sessions, completed activities or available recovery data. Context covers up to 28 days and 100 recent activities; the AI should identify missing data.
assistant_placeholder: Review this week’s completed activities and available metrics. What should I consider before planning the next session?
assistant_review_help: Replies are suggestions and are not saved as workouts. To change the calendar, open Review and adapt with AI, enter the coach’s decisions and review the proposal before accepting it. The conversation is not transferred automatically.
assistant_choose_plan: Select an athlete above to open the assistant.
assistant_provider_error: AI could not respond. Check its configuration or try again. The calendar has not changed.
garmin_manual_fit_checked: {count} FIT files reviewed. Previously imported activities are checked too. Cached files are reused and missing supported data is added; a reviewed FIT may contain no GPS.
garmin_manual_fit_incompatible: Some data from FIT files {ids} could not be aligned with the stored timestamps. Existing data is preserved; these activities need manual review.
garmin_manual_summary_help: Refresh recent activity summaries and recovery metrics. Use the separate action below to complete GPS and other FIT details.
garmin_manual_cooldown: Wait two minutes between Garmin updates before trying again.
garmin_manual_available_at: You can update again after {date}. No update starts automatically.
garmin_backfill_help: Complete FIT details for activities already in OpenAthlete, without querying recovery again. Cached files are reused. Each run downloads at most 20 new FIT files, with at least 15 seconds between requests, and stops on errors. These local precautions do not guarantee Garmin’s limits will not be reached. Continue only by pressing the button again.
garmin_backfill_pending: {count} activities pending completion. A FIT file may not contain GPS.
garmin_backfill_stopping: Stopping after the current request. No further files will be requested.
garmin_backfill_complete: Pending activities have been reviewed. All available supported FIT data has been imported.
garmin_backfill_cancelled: Stopped at your request. Completed imports are preserved; press the button to continue.
garmin_backfill_budget: The local limit for this run was reached. Completed imports are preserved; press the button to continue when available.
garmin_backfill_rate_limit: Garmin limited requests. Downloads have stopped and will not resume automatically.
garmin_backfill_cooldown: Paused to leave time between Garmin requests. Wait until the indicated time before continuing manually.
garmin_backfill_auth: Garmin needs a valid session. The athlete must reconnect Garmin before continuing.
garmin_backfill_busy: Another Garmin operation is running. Wait for it to finish before continuing.
garmin_backfill_interrupted: The previous run was interrupted. Completed imports are preserved; press the button to continue.
garmin_backfill_failed: Completion stopped after an error. Check the pending activities before trying again; no automatic retries are made.
garmin_backfill_progress: {checked} of {total} FIT files reviewed · {updated} activities enriched · {remaining} pending.
garmin_backfill_next_request: Next file request no earlier than {date}.
garmin_backfill_blocked_until: Garmin requests are paused until {date}. You can start a new action after that time; it will not start automatically.
provider_not_configured_help: This connector is not configured for this installation. Contact the administrator.
provider_configuration_unavailable: Could not check this connector’s configuration. Reload the page to try again.
activity_analysis_private: Private for you as the coach. Each valid analysis is saved with the context used so you can review it later.
activity_analysis_context_placeholder: What was the aim of this session? Add relevant sensations, constraints or specific questions for the analysis.
activity_analysis_disclosure: Generating sends the activity, your context and the available athlete data to the configured AI provider. Review the data first: linked prescription, RPE and feedback, recent activity and training load, recovery, goals and injuries when available.
activity_analysis_context_preview: Data that will be sent to AI
activity_analysis_generation_unavailable: Set up AI in Settings > AI to generate analyses. Your saved analyses remain available.
activity_analysis_copy_manually: Select and copy the feedback text manually. This browser cannot copy it automatically.
activity_analysis_invalid_error: AI returned an invalid analysis. Try generating again. No new analysis has been saved.
activity_analysis_busy_error: An analysis is already being generated for this activity. Wait a moment and reload the saved analyses.
activity_analysis_access_error: You do not have access to this activity, analysis or AI feature.
activity_analysis_request_error: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
activity_analysis_history_error: Saved analyses could not be loaded.
activity_analysis_empty: There are no saved analyses for this activity yet.
activity_analysis_history_limit: Your 20 most recent analyses of this activity.
activity_analysis_feedback_help: Review and edit this message before sharing it. Saving keeps it private; copying lets you send it yourself. The analysis does not change the training plan.
activity_analysis_unsaved_feedback: You have unsaved edits. Save or discard them before selecting another analysis or generating a new one.
activity_analysis_saved_context: Data used for this saved analysis
activity_alert_settings_help: Choose which automatic notifications to receive from this athlete in your conversation. Your preferences do not affect other coaches. They apply to future changes; existing notices are kept.
activity_alert_settings_error: Unable to load or save your preferences. Try again.
activity_alert_comment_updated: The athlete added or updated a comment
activity_alert_unavailable: The activity is no longer available or you do not have access.
coach_load_period: Current summary as of {date}, using the last 42 days.
coach_load_coverage: Only activities with calculated TRIMP are included. Missing loads are not a measure of rest.
coach_load_requirements: No calculated TRIMP loads in this period. Heart-rate streams, resting HR and maximum HR (metric or maximum of applicable HR zones) are required.
garmin_manual_history_incomplete: The full 42-day history could not be covered: the query limit was reached or Garmin repeated a page. Training loads may be incomplete.
coach_load_hr_priority: Opening or refreshing updates missing or changed loads and reuses saved ones. Maximum HR uses the metric first, then sport-specific or general HR zones if absent. No Garmin requests.
coach_load_hr_zones: Maximum HR from zones: {max} bpm; resting HR: {rest} bpm.
coach_load_hr_metric: Recorded maximum HR: {max} bpm; resting HR: {rest} bpm.
coach_load_auto_unavailable: Some activities lack valid pulse data or HR references. Any previous load for those activities is retained.
coach_load_ctl_help: Weighted average load over the last 42 days. Summarizes sustained load, giving more weight to recent days.
coach_load_atl_help: Weighted average load over the last 7 days. Reflects recent load and changes faster than CTL.
coach_load_tsb_help: Difference between CTL and ATL. A negative value means recent load exceeds sustained load; a positive value means it is lower. It does not determine recovery on its own.
feedback_not_generated: No questions have been generated yet.
feedback_generate_help: Sends this activity, latest metrics, zones and recorded injuries to the AI provider to create 3–4 questions. Existing questions and answers are preserved.
feedback_generation_disabled: AI questions are disabled for this athlete. Ask your coach to enable them.
feedback_ai_unavailable: AI questions are not available for this athlete.
feedback_generation_error: The AI returned questions in an invalid format. Generate them again. No answers have been replaced.
feedback_answer_save_error: The answer was not saved. Your text is preserved; please try again.
feedback_skip_error: Could not skip feedback. Please try again.
feedback_load_error: Could not load the questionnaire. Please try again.
feedback_model_not_configured: The AI provider selected for questions is not configured. Ask the administrator to check the model and its API key.
feedback_provider_error: Could not get a response from the AI provider. Try again; if it persists, ask the administrator to check model access and usage limits.
hr_zones_percentage_help: Limits are rounded to whole bpm. Each upper limit belongs to the next zone, except 100%. Zones are saved in bpm and do not automatically change with maximum or resting HR. These inputs do not update the athlete’s metrics.
hr_zones_max_required: Enter a whole-number maximum heart rate between 1 and 300 bpm.
hr_zones_conversion_error: Check maximum HR, resting HR and zone limits before switching units. Existing limits must be whole bpm, at or below maximum HR and, for reserve percentages, at or above resting HR.
hr_zones_invalid: Check zone names and limits. Percentages must be between 0 and 100 and produce a non-empty bpm range.
hr_zones_save_error: Some zones could not be saved. Review the values and retry; some changes may already have been saved.
hr_zones_resting_help: Use resting heart rate, not the lowest heart rate recorded during the day. Required only for heart-rate reserve.
hr_zones_reserve_formula: Target HR = resting HR + percentage × (maximum HR − resting HR). Switching between percentage methods keeps the percentages and recalculates the bpm ranges.
hr_zones_rest_required: Enter a whole-number resting heart rate greater than zero and below maximum heart rate.
activity_load_failed: Could not retrieve the saved training load.
activity_load_not_saved: No TRIMP load has been saved for this activity.
workout_zone_reference_help: Reusable zone: it uses the assigned athlete’s zone with the same name and type, for this sport.
workout_target_template_help: The target will be resolved using the athlete assigned to this template.
workout_target_missing_metric: Missing athlete metric: {metric}. Add it before assigning or saving this workout.
workout_target_missing_zone: The athlete has no matching zone “{zone}” for this sport. Configure it or choose another target.
workout_target_ambiguous_zone: More than one zone matches “{zone}”. Review the athlete’s zones before saving.
workout_target_invalid: Check the target: its reference and range must be valid. No changes have been saved.
workout_target_data_error: Could not load the athlete’s metrics or zones. Try again.
messages_search_description: Search by text, sender or chat name. Select a result to jump to the message.
messages_search_hint: Type to search the message history.
week_targets_help: Targets are compared with the week totals in the week view. Leave a field empty to remove it.
week_targets_invalid: Volume must be between 0 and 100 hours and load between 0 and 10,000.
week_copied: Week copied ({count} items). Open another week and paste it.
week_move_help: {count} planned sessions and notes will move to the same weekdays and times. Completed sessions, activities and races stay.
week_move_target: Any day of the destination week
week_clear_confirm: Delete {count} planned sessions and notes of this week? Completed sessions, activities and races are kept. This cannot be undone.
week_action_error: The week action failed. Nothing may have changed; reload to check.
week_panel_empty: No sessions or activities this week.
signup_email_exists: An account with this email already exists.
signup_failed: The account could not be created. Check the details and try again.
signup_login_failed: Your account was created, but signing in failed.
garmin_sync_failed: The Garmin update failed. No changes were saved.
garmin_manual_owned_elsewhere: Some Garmin activities already belong to another athlete in OpenAthlete, so they were skipped. The same Garmin account is probably connected to more than one athlete.
admin_delete_confirm: Permanently delete {email} and all their data (activities, plans, messages, settings)? This cannot be undone.
admin_delete_failed: The account could not be deleted. Administrator accounts cannot be deleted.
access_tokens_description: Read-only tokens that let AI assistants such as Claude read your training data through the OpenAthlete MCP server. They cannot change anything. Revoke a token if you no longer use it.
access_token_create_failed: The token could not be created. You can have up to 10 active tokens.
access_token_shown_once: Copy this token now: it will not be shown again.
access_token_setup_help: To use it in Claude Code, run this command after building the MCP server (pnpm --filter @openathlete/mcp build), replacing the path with your repository folder:
access_token_copy_failed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it manually.
access_token_revoke_confirm: Revoke the token "{name}"? Assistants using it will lose access immediately.
pwa_install_ios_steps: Tap the browser's Share button and choose “Add to Home Screen”. OpenAthlete then opens full screen from its icon, like an app.
garmin_workout_outdated: Changed since it was sent to Garmin
garmin_workout_sent_toast: Session sent to Garmin. It reaches the watch at the watch's next sync.
garmin_workout_remove_confirm: The session will be removed from the Garmin calendar and workout library. It stays in OpenAthlete.
garmin_week_nothing: There are no upcoming sessions to send this week
garmin_workout_wait: Garmin needs a pause between operations. Try again in {seconds} s.
garmin_workout_wait_later: Garmin needs a pause between operations. Try again in a few minutes.
garmin_workout_past: Past sessions are not sent to Garmin.
garmin_workout_targets: Some targets need athlete zones or metrics that are missing.
garmin_workout_failed: Garmin did not respond correctly. Try again later.
garmin_workout_delete_note: This session is also in Garmin. Deleting it here does not remove it from Garmin: first use “Remove from Garmin” in the session details.
garmin_manual_onboarding_help: Unofficial connector of this installation: sign in with your Garmin account and update whenever you want. It does not need the official Garmin integration.
garmin_login_reconnect_help: Use it if you changed your Garmin password, the session expired or you connected the wrong account. Activities already imported are kept.
ai_structure_title: Turn a written workout into steps
ai_structure_help: Write the workout as you would say it. The AI turns it into steps and repetition blocks, using the athlete's zones when you mention them. The name, date and goals do not change.
ai_structure_placeholder: 15-20' warm-up + 3x8' at RPE 6-7, ~4:35-4:40/km, 3' very easy jog recovery + cool-down
ai_structure_replace: The current steps will be replaced.
ai_structure_done: Structure created. Review it before saving.
ai_structure_failed: The structure could not be created. Try again or describe it differently.
ai_convert_as_written_help: Already have the workout written? “Convert as written” turns it into steps and repeat blocks without adding anything, using less AI.
coach_self_help: You are also an athlete: add yourself to your athletes to plan your own training from the coach space, with the same tools as for any athlete.
coach_self_added: You are now among your athletes
coach_self_failed: You could not be added to your athletes
coach_self_stop_confirm: You will no longer appear among your athletes. Your training data is kept.
onboarding_coach_self: Also coach myself (I will appear among my athletes)
ai_settings_description: Connect an API key from the AI provider of your choice and pick the model each feature uses. Keys are encrypted and never displayed again; your data is sent only to the provider you choose.
ai_hosted_included_description: Features without a key of yours run on this instance's AI keys.
ai_usage_exhausted: Used up. Features without a key of yours are paused until {date}.
ai_usage_own_keys: {tokens} tokens on your own keys, billed by your provider.
ai_upgrade_description: A paid plan includes AI on our keys, with no provider account needed.
ai_keys_description: Keys of the AI providers you use: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, OpenRouter and many more.
ai_keys_empty: No key yet. Add one to start using AI features.
ai_key_add_description: The key is encrypted on the server and only used for your requests.
ai_key_base_url_hint: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, for example http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
ai_key_model: Model to test the key with
ai_key_model_hint: Optional. If you have no default model yet, this one becomes it.
ai_key_save_failed: The key could not be saved
ai_key_form_invalid: Choose a provider and fill in the required fields.
ai_key_delete_confirm: Features using this key will stop until you choose another model.
ai_models_description: The model each feature runs on. Features without their own choice use the default model.
ai_models_no_keys: Add a key to choose your models.
ai_models_model_required: Enter a model for each feature that uses a key.
ai_task_default_description: Used by every feature without a model of its own.
ai_task_event_generation_description: Creates a session from your description.
ai_task_event_modification_description: Changes a session as you ask.
ai_task_post_activity_questions_descript: Asks the athlete about a finished activity.
ai_task_feedback_extraction_description: Reads effort and injuries from the athlete’s answers.
ai_task_training_load_estimation_descrip: Estimates the load of planned sessions.
ai_task_plan_generation_description: Drafts a whole plan in Planning. Works best with a large model.
ai_task_plan_adaptation_description: Proposes changes to an ongoing plan and answers questions about an athlete.
ai_task_activity_analysis_description: Analyses a completed activity for the coach.
ai_task_workout_parser_description: Turns sessions written in plain words into structured steps. A small, fast model is enough.
ai_task_ai_memory_description: Summarises the notes the AI keeps about each athlete. A small model is enough.
ai_setup_description: AI features run on your own AI provider account: add an API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral or another provider in the settings. You only pay your provider for what you use.
ai_setup_or_subscribe: Or subscribe to a plan that includes AI, with no key to manage.
ai_feedback_questions_off_title: No AI questions for this activity
ai_feedback_questions_off_description: Add your own AI key to get questions after each activity.
ai_error_not_configured: Set up an AI provider key in Settings > AI to use this feature.
ai_error_credential_rejected: Your AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings > AI.
ai_error_quota_exceeded: Your AI provider's quota is exhausted or rate limited. Try again later or check your provider account.
ai_error_hosted_quota_exceeded: You have used the AI included in your plan for this month. Add your own key in Settings > AI to keep going.
ai_error_provider: The AI provider could not complete the request. Try again or choose another model.
